name: Prenylamine
summary: Prenylamine (Segontin) is a calcium channel blocker of the amphetamine chemical class that was used as a vasodilator in the treatment of angina pectoris. It produces amphetamine as a metabolite.

pharmacology.text: Prenylamine has two primary molecular targets in humans: calmodulin and myosin light-chain kinase 2, found in skeletal and cardiac muscle. Pharmacologically, it decreases sympathetic stimulation on cardiac muscle, predominantly through partial depletion of catecholamines via competitive inhibition of reuptake by storage granules, leading to further depletion due to spontaneous leakage as a result of disturbance of equilibrium.

uses.text: Prenylamine (Segontin) is a calcium channel blocker of the amphetamine chemical class that was used as a vasodilator in the treatment of angina pectoris.

sideEffects.en: Its most serious risk is a dangerous heart rhythm disturbance called torsades de pointes, which can be fatal and led to its withdrawal. Because it is partly turned into amphetamine, stimulant effects are also possible.
sideEffects.zh: 它最嚴重的風險是一種稱為尖端扭轉型室性心搏過速的危險心律不整，可能致命，也是它下市的原因。由於它部分會轉變為安非他命，也可能出現興奮劑作用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它最严重的风险是一种称为尖端扭转型室性心搏过速的危险心律不整，可能致命，也是它下市的原因。由于它部分会转变为安非他命，也可能出现兴奋剂作用。

fact.en: Prenylamine was withdrawn from sale worldwide in the late 1980s after it was linked to a dangerous heart rhythm disturbance. Part of it is broken down in the body to amphetamine.
fact.zh: 普尼拉明在 1980 年代後期因與危險的心律不整有關而在全球下市。它在體內有一部分會被代謝成安非他命。
fact.zhHans: 普尼拉明在 1980 年代后期因与危险的心律不整有关而在全球下市。它在体内有一部分会被代谢成安非他命。
